notes.title: [WIP] About new game
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796509/67f8f2a7458fdef4e7c0f3b55367173b2dbf61c7.png[/img]

About the new game in development

The game currently looks like it will proceed in a take-and-complete job format. I try to make everything as realistic as possible. 

Also, we now have a phone in the game.
We will be able to receive 2FA verification codes from this phone.
Additionally, some applications and stats will be managed from the phone.
We talked about character stats, yes, our characters will now have stats. We will control this from an application on the phone and by increasing some of our skills we will access applications and methods that we cannot access in the game.

The current trend is towards earning money and xp every time we complete a job. We will gain 1 skill point every time we level up. And we will level up our skills with these skill points. 

I made a lot of changes regarding the applications.We will now be able to open more than one of our applications. So this means multiple terminals and multiple browsers.

There are thousands of features and innovations that I haven't mentioned yet. However, I ask you to wait for the game.

Finally, when the single-player part of the game is finished, I am thinking of adding a multi-player mode where people can hack each other.
